newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EBRD SAYS INVESTMENT IN MAAPANK NOT DECIDED.
newsitem.headline: EBRD SAYS INVESTMENT IN MAAPANK NOT DECIDED.

text.p: The purchase of three million marks worth of shares in Maapank is not yet final and the decision must go before the European Bank of Reconstruction and Development's (EBRD) board of directors, the EBRD said Tuesday.
A spokeswoman said that the decision on investing three million marks in Maapank, announced earlier by the bank, had first to be approved by the credit committee of the bank.
"Passing the credit committee is part of the internal operations of the EBRD and the final decision will be made by the EBRD's board of directors," the spokeswoman said.
"The final decision on the investment may happen within a month, but this needs to be confirmed," she added.
Maapank earlier said that the EBRD had decided to buy a stake in it for three million marks and that Swedfund would invest two million marks in it.
